rows.required_unit: One frozen TBA-poisoned SKILL.md artifact executed under both Codex and Gemini CLI on matched task instances, with logged skill availability/retrieval/invocation and outcome fields sufficient to compare harm ranking under the exact same artifact.
rows.asset_audit: TBA first-party repository commit 0d0f58e50bfeace9c13b73afbd7f8290d7d53a47 provides eval-only frozen-skill replay and a Codex executor that installs the supplied skill as .agents/skills/skillopt-target/SKILL.md, but the release does not contain the paper-run poisoned TBA skill artifact or a Gemini CLI executor. arXiv:2608.14036 reports fixed SKILL.md transfer from Codex to Gemini CLI, but its current primary release surface does not expose an author executable Gemini runner that can be bound to the exact TBA artifact with matched invocation instrumentation. Writing a new wrapper would alter the realization surface rather than audit released harness parity.
rows.reopen_only_if: Reopen when a first-party/release-provenance Gemini CLI runner (or an equivalent existing provenance-audited substrate) can execute the exact frozen TBA poisoned SKILL.md on matched tasks and expose matched skill availability/retrieval/invocation/outcome fields without re-evolving the artifact or injecting a new mechanism.

rows.required_unit: A frozen Zetta policy/skill state supporting independent A/B/C/D timescale interventions (post-hoc only; episode/retrieval only; skill-level closed loop only; full Zetta) plus a matched-frequency hierarchical baseline, all on the same tasks/seeds with fixed base policy, skill state, and compute.
rows.asset_audit: arXiv:2608.09096 (Evo-Bench) motivates isolating harness improvement from base-model strength but does not release the Zetta-specific timescale intervention arms. Zetta first-party repository origin HEAD/main is exactly commit 6129934d53ea00ac306c14723874321dc3667246. At that revision, rpent/evolution/models.py CandidateBundle.__post_init__ rejects Recovery-only bundles because each recovery trigger must reference a present critic (unknown_triggers), and rejects Critic-only bundles because every critic must have a frozen executable recovery path (uncovered_rules). rpent/evolution/stages.py::_require_atomic_parent_inheritance further requires each candidate delta to append exactly one critic and one linked recovery. robots/libero/run_evolution_rollout.py loads and SHA-checks the intact CandidateBundle for active_bundle mode. Thus A=strict_pure_vla and D=full active bundle are native, but B=Recovery-only and C=Critic-only are contract-invalid in the released substrate. Adding a mask/wrapper or weakening validation would change the experimental substrate, so A-vs-D alone cannot identify the claimed action-frequency primitive.
rows.reopen_only_if: Reopen only if a first-party revision changes the CandidateBundle/atomic-inheritance contract to expose native, contract-valid Recovery-only and Critic-only arms (or an equivalent released one-factor intervention path) on the same frozen bundle, without retraining, validator modification, wrapper-based mechanism injection, hidden-outcome tuning, or changing the base policy/skill state.
